description: Source code for a TypeScript compiler utility class that sets up a virtual TypeScript environment, manages compilation options, and compiles code snippets.

classes.name: Compiler
classes.description: A class that manages a virtual TypeScript environment, including setup and compilation of code snippets.

methods.name: setup

methods.name: compile
